messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is usually **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods the gap widens to **10 hours** because both regions shift forward one hour at roughly the same time of year.

| Period | Los Angeles (UTC offset) | Berlin (UTC offset) | Difference |
|--------|--------------------------|---------------------|------------|
| Standard time (roughly early November – mid‑March) | UTC‑8 (PST) | UTC +1 (CET) | +9 h (Berlin ahead) |
| Daylight‑saving time (mid‑March – early November) | UTC‑7 (PDT) | UTC +2 (CEST) | +10 h (Berlin ahead) |

So if it’s 12:00 pm noon in Los Angeles during winter, it’s 9:00 pm in Berlin; during summer, 12:00 pm in Los Angeles corresponds to 10:00 pm in Berlin.
